meta.note: Rebuilt by scripts/import-public-edition-calendar.cjs. Every event's source is the Public Edition's copy of its organizer's calendar, so src is not repeated on each one: the app builds it from org and status. `status` is how the Public Edition found the listing: library or organizer (on that calendar when checked), recheck (from earlier research; recheck before going), season (a program-season window). `fit` is family, caregiver or general. `ages` uses baby, toddler, preschool, school, teen and adult.
